senses.definition: A device that produces a monochromatic, coherent beam of light.
A beam of light produced by such a device; a laser beam.

quotes.text: The bad news is that nearly every color laser is too big to share a desk with comfortably.
quotes.reference: 2004 May 18, PC Mag, volume 23, number 9, page 117:

senses.definition: (uncountable, medicine) Ellipsis of laser hair removal.
examples: I've still got a few more sessions of laser to get rid of the rest of my facial hair.

senses.definition: (transitive) To cut, destroy or treat with a laser.
examples: I'm having my eyes lasered to correct my astigmatism.

senses.definition: (sports, informal, transitive) To throw or kick with laser-like precision.

quotes.text: None was any more sensational than No.6, a fantastic 27-23 last-gasp win over the Arizona Cardinals, cemented by a brilliant toe-sticking TD catch by Santonio Holmes in the back of the end zone with 35 seconds remaining on a pass lasered by quarterback Ben Roethlisberger.
quotes.reference: 2009 February 2, Dave Perkins, “Steelers tiptoe past Cards”, in Toronto Star:

senses.definition: (aviation) To point a laser at an aircraft, potentially disorienting the pilot or pilots.
A gum resin obtained from certain umbelliferous plants.
